# HarnessDock v0.1.7-rc.1

HarnessDock aligns its sealed desktop Runtime with DeepSeek Harness `dsh-v0.1.7-rc.1`.

## Runtime alignment

- Pin dsh exactly to `0.1.7-rc.1` at commit `46a7f68b0922371ce7144b668b90e377d8e799f4`.
- Preserve sealed/offline Runtime identity validation.
- Preserve Runtime Update V2 A/B activation and automatic rollback.
- Preserve Plugin Manager V2 exact dsh-version + runtime-image + launch-scope quarantine binding.

## Upstream compatibility

- Keep plugin execution owned by DeepSeek Harness while HarnessDock manages host lifecycle/recovery metadata.
- Accommodate upstream plugin compatibility checks and optional-plugin fail-open behavior.
- Keep private Rescue Web for profile/startup failures.
- Keep the upstream pnpm 11.7.0 toolchain inside the sealed Runtime.

## Validation

- Tauri-only desktop architecture.
- Same-SHA CI, Tauri CI and local one-click gates remain required before release.
- This commit updates the development branch only; it does not merge PR #98.
